user.title: Connect to MeshCore MQTT
user.description: Enter the connection details for your MeshCore MQTT broker.

data_description.host: Hostname of the MQTT broker (e.g. subscriber.dutchmeshcore.nl)
data_description.port: TCP port, typically 443 for WebSocket over TLS
data_description.iata: 2–4 uppercase letters identifying the mesh region (e.g. AMS)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the MQTT broker. Check host, port, and network.
error.invalid_iata: IATA code must be 2–4 uppercase letters (e.g. AMS).

abort.already_configured: This broker and region are already configured.

init.title: MeshCore MQTT Recorder — Channels
init.description: Enter the hashtag channel names you want to monitor (without the # prefix). Only lowercase letters, digits, and interior hyphens are allowed.

error.invalid_channel_name: One or more channel names are invalid. Use lowercase letters, digits, and interior hyphens only (no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens; max 30 characters).
